scope: Offline post-pilot arithmetic analyzer; no actual pilot output was read while designing or testing this code.

corrections: Pre-generation failure remains infrastructure/capacity evidence even when generation count is zero.
Expected timeout without a completed response is not automatically artifact corruption; partial content availability is recorded without extracting a portfolio.
Common-market declared evidence IDs are included alongside actual supplied source/common/feedback declarations.
L_D0 has no source document and source fidelity is not applicable.
Case/stage identity and actual source visibility are checked before output parsing; integrity failures cannot leave an eligible vector.
Zero-call transport integrity/status fields remain visible.

policy.eligibility: Whole preserved response must parse as one JSON object with complete finite nonnegative 11-vector passing inherited sum tolerance. Explanatory schema failure and length stop are reported separately and do not censor eligible vectors.

test_coverage: Exact analytical distances and decimal raw differences
Invalid budget stays raw; valid distance null with reason
Missing, duplicate, unknown, boolean, negative and nonfinite weights
Whole JSON required; no code-fence/partial extraction
Schema failure and length stop separated from vector eligibility
All-five/ten planned denominators with missing cases
One shared source-independent C and L_D0 no-source status
Bound response hash and stage/source identity failures
Zero-call preflight/capacity failure and expected timeout partial text
No response artifact opens before completion marker
limitations: Arithmetic verification does not validate an AI semantic scorer.
The report is descriptive, with no institution-specific numeric gold, causal/population inference or strategy performance claim.
The final run is not analyzed until pilot_summary.json marks completion.
Root third integration and live-run rejection checks are separate receipts.
